name: Chocoladefabriken Lindt & Sprüngli AG
summary: Chocoladefabriken Lindt & Sprüngli AG, including its subsidiaries, operates globally as a manufacturer and seller of chocolate confectionery. The company markets its wide range of products under well-known brand names such as Lindt, Ghirardelli, Russell Stover, Whitman's, Caffarel, Hofbauer, Küfferle, and Pangburn's. It engages with consumers through an expansive network of distributors and approximately 500 company-owned retail locations. This enterprise was founded in 1845 and its corporate headquarters are situated in Kilchberg, Switzerland.
